comparison.objective: Rotate two hurdles so their feet face the runners' approach; unlike shock-absorber tuning.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-object reorientation and placement on marks; no tool insertion, retained adjustment, or dynamic-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Each upright hurdle on its marks with feet toward the start scores 0.5. No numeric placement tolerance or spec versions are stated.
comparison.reason: Tests orientation knowledge and gross placement rather than fine mechanical commissioning.
